race.comment: CAMDEN COVE (1) was a big winner of a couple of trials prior to making his debut with a fourth at Hawkesbury, and then finishing a weakening third off the front at Goulburn 2 weeks ago over 1100m. He still has some maturing to do, so dropping back to 1000m will suit him, and with the aid of a 2kg claim, he is the one to beat in this. CHUMPAKIDD (2) had a very tough trip fresh up when trapped wide throughout, and that run is best forgotten. This is a much easier assignment, and from a superior gate, he will be a quick improver. Each way. KENNEDY COMPOUND (4) will give the Baker stable a strong hand as one of 3 starters in this field. She was a beaten favourite on debut here in February on a heavy track, finishing second, and resumes off the back of a couple of quiet trials. She is stronger now, and can set the record straight. Follow the market. PAPER DOLL (5) is a lightly tried 6YO mare who resumes with the winkers replacing the blinkers. She is honest, so include.
